dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Now then, we have one more thing we must prepare.

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Do you know what it is we need to prepare,
<$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>That’s exactly right, <$cdef(27)>!
<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>We’re going to use <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to supply electricity to
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1703)>!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Then we might be able to brighten the whole town—and
keep it that way!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Hohoho! Then allow me to explain!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,9)>This time, you’ll be using <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to supply
electricity to <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1703)>!
<$voicel(1,7)>Once you’ve powered up several <$cdef(27)>streetlights, <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>we may be
able to brighten this town up—and keep it that way!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>That’s where you come in, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,5)>Could we ask you to prepare a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1703)> and
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>place it near the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> you set up earlier?

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I wonder if it will light up properly... Ohhh, I’ll be waiting
on tenterhooks!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, I’m sure it will be just fine...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Could we ask you to place a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1703)> near the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> you set up earlier?

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I wonder if it will light up properly... Ohhh, I’ll be waiting
on tenterhooks!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>You’ve done it! The <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1703)> </color>lit up!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>Yes! Well done indeed, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Once you connect a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to the <$cdef(27)><$bfull(33)>,
<$voicel(1,8)>you can then add more poles to transport electricity to
the <$cdef(27)>streetlights.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>That should help brighten up the whole town!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Right, and it might even be enough to get <$cdef(27)>Snorlax to open
their eyes!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>If there’s anything you don’t understand along the way,
you can always come ask me for help!

<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,668)><$voicel(2,9)>I have the utmost faith in you, <$cdef(27)>.
Please
give
it
your all!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, hey, <$cdef(27)>! You’re trying to light
up
this
town, right?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,7)>I was trying to come up with ways I could help, but...<$voicel(4,5)>I don’t
think there’s much I can do, since I can’t use electricity...
<$emotion(4,18)><$voicel(4,4)>It’s got me feeling kind of sad...

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>I wanted to play real hard to clear my head, so I was
wondering...is there a waterwheel around here?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, um... It’s this big, round machine that, like, spins when
water flows over it. <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>I love splashing around near them,
they’re so much fun!

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>If you do find a waterwheel, could you take me to it?<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)> I bet
I’ll get a good idea as I play!
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>If you do find a waterwheel, could you take me to it?

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I bet once I play a bit and clear my head, I’ll have some
ideas for how to help make the town brighter!

You found something that looks like a waterwheel!
Bring <$cdef(27)>Piplup to check it out!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, wow! You found a waterwheel!
<$emotion(4,41)><$voicel(4,3)>But, uhhh...it looks like it’s not moving.

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I think we can make it spin if we can get some water to
flow over here...

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>I wonder if there’s anywhere nearby that has enough water
for that?

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,3)><$kfacial(4)>I’m real happy you found me a waterwheel, but...it’s not
working, is it?

<$voicel(4,5)>I think we can make it spin if we can get some water to
flow over here...

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>I wonder if there’s anywhere nearby that has enough water
for that?

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Oh, hey! The waterwheel’s moving!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>You fixed it up, didn’t you, <$cdef(27)>?
Thank
you
so much!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Now I get to splash around near it as much as I like!

This <$cdef(27)><$bfull(34)> is actually a generator that produces
electricity using hydropower!
Connect <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to it to transmit electricity over
long distances!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Yayyy! The waterwheel’s running! I bet it’ll be so much fun
to play in the water here!

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>You found this, right, <$cdef(27)>?<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)> Thanks
for
bringing
me here!

This <$cdef(27)><$bfull(34)> is actually a generator that produces
electricity using hydropower!
Connect <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to it to transmit electricity over
long distances!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>, listen!
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>So, um, you’re trying to make the whole town brighter
using electricity, right?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I was thinking and thinking and trying to come up with a
good idea to help...<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>and then I remembered something!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>You can make electricity by burning up lots and LOTS of
stuff all at once!

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,7)>I don’t really get how it works or anything.
<$voicel(4,5)>I just know people would throw stuff they didn’t need into
this big, tough-looking machine, and burn it!

<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>If you find a weird-looking machine like that, can you take
me to it, please? <$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Maybe I can help out!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>I heard you can make electricity by burning up stuff you
don’t need.

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)><$kfacial(4)>You’re s’posed to burn lots ’n’ lots of stuff in a big,
tough-looking machine!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>If you find a weird-looking machine like that, can you
please take me to it?

You found a big, tough-looking machine! The inside is
burnt and blackened...
Try bringing <$cdef(27)>Torchic </color>here!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Yes, <$cdef(27)>! This is it! This is the thing I
was
talking about!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>The machine you can use to make electricity by
burning stuff! <$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>I can tell just by looking at it!
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>But it looks like it’s not working right now.
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Do you think it’ll work if we put something in it to burn?

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Do you think this machine’ll start working if we put
something in it to burn?
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>YAAAY! It’s burning the stuff! I guess it still works!

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>But...what do we do now? How do we get the electricity?
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Ngh, I dunno how to do it, but I bet YOU can figure it out
no problem, <$cdef(27)>!

As a matter of fact, the <$cdef(27)><$bfull(35)> is already generating
electricity. Connect <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to it to transmit
electricity over long distances!

To run the <$cdef(27)><$bfull(35)>, you need burnable materials.
The more you burn, the more electricity you can generate!
